Create a I/O limit policy.

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | I/O limit policy name. |
| `description` | string | I/O limit policy description. |
| `isShared` | boolean | Indicates whether the I/O limits defined in the I/O limit policy are shared among all assigned storage resources. Default to false |
| `type` | `IOLimitPolicyTypeEnum` | \|Name\|Value\|Description\| \|----------\|----------\|----------\| \|Absolute\|1\|Absolute Value\| \|Density_Based\|2\|Density-based Value\| |
| `ioLimitRules` | array of `ioLimitRuleSetting` | I/O limit rules associated with the I/O limit policy, as defined by the ioLimitRuleSetting resource type. Only one ioLimitRule is supported at this time per policy. |
| `luns` | array of object | LUNs to which the I/O limit policy applies, as defined by the lun resource type. |
| `snaps` | array of object | Snaps to which the I/O limit policy applies, as defined by the snap resource type. |

**Responses:** `201` Created body fields: `@base`, `updated`, `links`, `content`
